entities.name: Query PIF1 helicase
observations: 768 aa protein with a long low-complexity, Lys/Arg/Ser/Pro-rich N-terminal region and a conserved C-terminal helicase core.
Pfam detects PIF1 domain at residues 418–620 and Pif1_2B_dom at residues 684–725; overlapping AAA-family ATPase profiles support an SF1 helicase motor.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is 84.3 kDa; predicted pI is 9.65; calculated charge at pH 7 is +22.9.
The N-terminus begins with a hydrophobic stretch, but the overall architecture and strong C-terminal PIF1 homology support a nuclear/organellar helicase rather than a secreted membrane protein.
